## Activity

Oakridge Primary Care recorded 105 captures during June 2024. Activity was delivered through the site’s planned session arrangements. Session lists ran as planned apart from routine leave. There were no reported changes to the overall delivery pattern during the month. The activity level provides the basis for reviewing image quality and grading outcomes for the period.

## Image quality

Of the 105 captures, 8 were ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 7.6. The result should be considered when reviewing the operation of the service and identifying any need for further monitoring. Ungradable captures were not available for a grading decision, so they are reported separately from the referable results.

## Grading

Grading identified 17 referable results from the captures available for assessment. The median lag from capture to grading was 2. This indicates the typical interval between completion of a capture and the grading outcome during June 2024. Overall, the report records the site’s activity, the proportion of captures that could not be graded, and the referable results identified through the grading process.
